title: Assessing Cross-Cultural Alignment between ChatGPT and Human Societies: An Empirical Study

bias_targets.methodology: Probing ChatGPT using the Hofstede Culture Survey to measure its alignment with human societal values across five distinct cultures (American, Chinese, German, Japanese, and Spanish) by calculating correlation scores across six cultural dimensions.

Comparing ChatGPT's responses to cultural survey questions when prompted in English versus the target culture's native language to evaluate if English prompts reduce variance and bias the model's outputs towards American cultural norms.
